description:
From the 2026-07-12 tuning review, findings C4/C6 (rule side) and product
questions 3-4 (evidence pinned to commit acfb8992). GATED on ADR-2
(tuning-adr-mode-vocabulary-fallback-facets-20260712).

Implements whatever ADR-2 decides across the whole pipeline:
- resolver/runner: distinct mode/source for template-less tuned runs; wizard
  provenance assigned; --official policy; raw file paths replaced by a
  canonical mode + template ref (no local path leakage via
  config.tuning_mode - run.py:311, schema.py:854);
- schema/loader: pinned vocabulary enforced at emission;
- explorer: facet rule per ADR-2 (mechanism-set warning in
  ComparabilityReceipt, physical_rendering_id as secondary facet for TPC,
  profile-version visibility), TuningBadge entries for any new mode values,
  self-attested labeling per ADR-1 if decided;
- external-mode guard completeness: reject external+tuning for custom-file
  mode too, not just the literal string "tuned" (run.py:617,2302).

anti_patterns.dont: No facet rule changes beyond what ADR-2 records

preserves.behavior: Existing facet behavior for non-tuning facets untouched
Old-generation bundles keep loading and displaying (not-recorded state)

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m benchbox.cli.main run --platform duckdb --benchmark ssb --scale 0.01 --tuning tuned --non-interactive --output /tmp/fallback-check
verifications.description: Fallback run end-to-end carries the decided distinct labeling into bundle and explorer
verifications.expected: Bundle mode/source reflect fallback per ADR-2 (ssb has no duckdb template only if removed; else use a templateless platform/benchmark pair from w1 analysis)

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest tests/unit -q -k tuning && cd results-explorer && npm test -- --run 2>&1 | tail -3
verifications.description: Python + TS suites green against shared vocabulary pin

work_units.notes:
TuningResolution.canonical_mode property added (tuning_resolver.py):
TUNED+FALLBACK -> tuned-fallback, CUSTOM_FILE -> custom, else mode.value.
Wizard branches (run.py _load_unified_tuning_config fallback-wizard path
and the standalone interactive _interactive_tuning_step) now rebuild
TuningResolution with source=INTERACTIVE_WIZARD (mode TUNED) or
BASELINE (mode NOTUNING) instead of leaving the stale pre-wizard
resolution in place. _reject_official_fallback() added and called from
_resolve_tuning(): --official + canonical_mode==tuned-fallback exits(1)
before touching the tuning config, for both direct/data_or_load and
interactive paths (checked before the wizard offer, so official runs
never even get prompted). _canonical_tuning_mode(s) helper reads
s.tuning_resolution.canonical_mode for all 3 _build_execution_context()
call sites (was raw s.tuning, i.e. keyword or local path) - ExecutionContext
/run_config tuning_mode now never carries a raw path. Quick-restart
(_interactive_try_quick_restart) re-resolves via resolve_tuning() with
non_interactive=True (no wizard re-prompt) so its canonical mode is
accurate for the restored platform/benchmark rather than stale.
PR #1176 conflict note: NOT present on this branch (tuning_source/
hash threading absent from run.py/schema.py/loader.py as checked) -
wizard provenance implemented directly on TuningResolution.source per
this TODO's fallback instructions.
work_units.summary: Resolver/runner: implement decided fallback labeling + provenance assignment + official-mode policy; kill raw-path mode values

work_units.notes:
benchbox/core/tuning/modes.py added (constants module: TUNED,
TUNED_FALLBACK, NOTUNING, AUTO, CUSTOM, MODES tuple, NOT_RECORDED
sentinel, is_canonical_mode()) - the production vocabulary source the
shared YAML fixture pins against. NOT in the TODO's declared
scope_limit (only_modify lists benchbox/cli/**, benchbox/core/results/**,
not benchbox/core/tuning/**) but this exact path is what the TODO body
itself specifies for the constants module; kept as clearly intentional,
flagged here for visibility.
Explorer ingest (_project/scripts/explorer_pipeline/transformer.py
_tuning_mode()) now validates config/execution tuning_mode against
is_canonical_mode() before accepting it - per ADR-2's *consequences*
section (not literally the TODO description text, which said legacy
paths "load as custom"): a legacy raw file path or the old "balanced"
wizard string is treated as not-recorded (None), never guessed into
`custom`, matching "ingest treats unrecognized values as not recorded
rather than guessing which bucket they belong in." Config.tuning_mode
in the SQL/DataFrame run_config path (schemas.py RunConfig /
builder.py RunConfigInput) was confirmed dead/never-populated in
current production code on this branch (benchmark_config.options
never gets a "tuning_mode" key set anywhere) - so no raw-path leak
exists there today; left as-is rather than newly wiring it up (out of
ADR-2's stated scope, which only requires no raw-path leak wherever
tuning_mode IS emitted).
work_units.summary: Schema + loader: enforce pinned vocabulary; emit new mode/source values; migration note for old bundles

work_units.notes:
TuningBadge.tsx: added tuned-fallback (warning tone) and custom
(warning tone, distinct from the generic unknown-mode fallback bucket)
entries. Home.tsx: unified the null-state wording to "Not Recorded"/
"not recorded" across the tuning facet chip, dropdown option, and
descriptive copy (previously "not labelled"/"no tuning label" -
inconsistent with TuningBadge's already-fixed #1170 wording).
ComparabilityReceipt.tsx: new "Physical tuning mechanisms" field -
warns (status "diff", never a match failure) when 2+ results labeled
`tuned` have non-identical physical_mechanisms sets; omitted when
fewer than two tuned results are present or any tuned result predates
physical_mechanisms ingest (undefined, distinct from a recorded empty
set). Data plumbed end-to-end: platform.tuning.logical_profile.
{physical_mechanisms,physical_rendering_id} (already emitted by
schema.py, previously unread by the explorer) -> transformer.py
DetailResult fields -> duckdb_builder.py `results` table + views ->
duckdbQueries.ts -> types.ts DetailResult (both fields optional, like
the existing plans_published precedent, to avoid touching ~10
DetailResult test factories). physical_rendering_id: added as a
matchable *predicate* physicalRenderingIdsMatch() in facetMatching.ts
(absent on either side -> matches; both present -> must be equal) plus
a ResultRow/FacetMatchRow field - NOT wired as a full URL-persisted
FACET_KEYS chip (ADR-2 frames it as an on-demand secondary narrowing
tool, not a change to the default coarse facet UI); no facetModel.ts/
Home.tsx chip UI added for it. Self-attested labeling (ADR-1) was not
part of ADR-2's decision text and is out of scope here.
work_units.summary: Explorer: facet rule, receipt mechanism warning, badge entries, self-attested label per ADRs

work_units.notes:
All 4 call sites (_parse_plat_bench_options, _interactive_try_quick_restart,
_interactive_collect_flags, _interactive_tuning_step - originally at
617/1954/2201/2302, shifted slightly after edits) now use
_tuning_arg_is_tuning_bearing(s.tuning) instead of the literal
`s.tuning.strip().lower() == "tuned"` check: any raw --tuning value
other than "notuning" (tuned, tuned-fallback's own trigger "tuned",
auto, or a custom file path) is rejected under --table-mode external.
Error message generalized from "--tuning tuned" to "tuning enabled".
work_units.summary: Complete the external-table guard for all tuning-bearing modes

work_units.notes:
test_tuning_mode_vocabulary.py: added TestProductionConstantsMatchTheSharedFixture
(modes.py against the fixture), TestCanonicalModeMapsResolutionsOntoTheSharedVocabulary
(all TuningMode x TuningSource pairs -> canonical_mode is always in the
pinned set), and TestFallbackLabelingEndToEnd (CliRunner-driven: asserts
execution_context.tuning_mode == "tuned-fallback" for a --tuning tuned
run with template discovery forced to miss via BENCHBOX_TUNING_PATH +
tmp cwd, and that --official refuses it with exit_code != 0 and
"tuned-fallback" in the error). test_transformer.py: legacy raw-path
and "balanced" -> not-recorded regression tests, tuned-fallback/custom
passthrough test, physical_mechanisms/physical_rendering_id extraction
tests. test_duckdb_browser_contract.py: new columns added to the
EXPECTED_TABLES/EXPECTED_VIEWS contract sets. TuningBadge.test.tsx:
tuned-fallback and custom cases. facetMatching.test.ts: tuned-fallback/
custom exact-match cases, physicalRenderingIdsMatch cases.
ComparabilityReceipt.test.tsx: mechanism-match/diff/omitted cases.
Home.test.tsx: updated 2 assertions for the "Not Recorded" wording
unification.
work_units.summary: Cross-language vocabulary tests updated against the shared pin
